    Semaphore ¶ class asyncio.Semaphore(value=1) ¶ A Semaphore object. Not thread-safe. A semaphore manages an internal counter which is decremented by each acquire () call and incremented by each release () call. The counter can never go below zero; when acquire () finds that it is zero, it blocks, waiting until some task calls release ().
